questions.question: Explain why 800 increased by 12% can be found with a single multiplication, and give the result.
questions.expected_answer: After the increase you have 100% + 12% = 112% of the original, which is the multiplier 1,12. So 800 × 1,12 = 896.

questions.question: A price rises from R40 to R50 and later falls back to R40. Why are the percentage increase and decrease different?
questions.expected_answer: Percentage change is change over original. Rising: 10/40 = 25%. Falling: 10/50 = 20%. The original is different in each direction.

questions.question: A jacket costs R360 after a 20% discount. Find the original price and explain why adding 20% of R360 is wrong.
questions.expected_answer: The sale price is 80% of the original, so the original is 360 ÷ 0,8 = R450. The discount was 20% of the original, not of the sale price, so adding 20% of 360 undercounts it.
